geometry_edits.rationale: Open the split more to create a clearer public seam aligned with neighborhood entry logic.
Retain a grounded connector so the split reads as one building with an active base rather than two colliding pieces.
Thicken the ground spine to strengthen the public threshold and improve programmatic anchoring at the street edge.
Enlarge the puncture slightly so it contributes more clearly to usable void logic instead of reading as minor perforation.
Reduce the lean so the section feels less arbitrary and more like a controlled upper-mass modulation.

graph_edits.rationale: Keep the dominant bar but re-express it as a cleaner anchored host so the mass reads less like a generic wedge and more like a stable neighborhood bar.
Preserve the long-axis dominance; the issue is not orientation but anchoring and threshold clarity.
Slightly strengthen the primary mass so the gesture reads as a more dominant building body rather than a thin sculptural wedge.
Widen the carve to produce a more legible public threshold and a usable void rather than a small puncture.
Increase depth so the ground response becomes spatially consequential and visible across views.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent single object in all four views, with a recognizable split-wing / punctured-bar idea and no obvious cross-view collision failures. However, the mass is still dominated by a tilted, wedge-like object whose public response to the verified access edge is weak: the blue frontage line is not met by a clearly open court, undercut, or entry seam. The voids are small and read more as punctures than as usable public space, so the neighborhood-active-ground requirement is only partially satisfied. In section, the form feels more sculptural than programmatic; it does not convincingly establish a calm active base plus legible upper hierarchy for neighborhood living. The silhouette is coherent but leans toward an arbitrary stepped/leaning landform rather than a robust public building section. The best transferable move from references is to strengthen the ground threshold and carve a larger, access-aligned void while preserving the dominant bar/split gesture.
